correctness.rationale: Every shortest path between same-part vertices contains every outside-part vertex as an admissible middle; two non-singleton parts force full convex closure. All proper convex sets are precisely clique partial transversals. Shattered support classification follows from explicit trace witnesses and a forbidden two-plus-one trace. The sharp online upper bound uses an all-positive path of \(r+1\) distinct queries, leaving only the full hypothesis. The inductive two-branch lower bound has base rank two for one block and gives rank \(r+1\). Standalone independent convexity, full-support, and version-space checks pass in seven finite instances through ten vertices.
